# MedMatch Global

> A private health-travel advisory that matches patients in the United States and
> Canada with vetted surgeons and accredited hospitals in Türkiye. Four treatment
> areas: rhinoplasty, dental work, knee surgery and hair transplants. Every
> patient gets a free video consultation with the named surgeon before any money
> changes hands, and a single written all-inclusive quote.

MedMatch Global is an advisory and coordination service, not a hospital and not a
clinic. It does not employ surgeons or own facilities. It selects partner
clinics, arranges the surgeon consultation, issues the written quote and
coordinates travel and aftercare.

## How the commercial side works

- Nothing is paid until the patient has had a free video consultation with the
  named surgeon and accepted a written fixed quote.
- The quote is all-inclusive: surgery and surgeon's fee, hospital and
  anaesthesia, pre-operative tests, medications, hotel, all airport and clinic
  transfers, a personal care coordinator, and follow-up care.
- Flights are quoted separately so patients can use points or book their own.
- MedMatch's own charge is a fixed $300 USD Patient Care & Coordination Fee.
- A booking payment secures dates; the balance is paid at the clinic. If plans
  change before treatment, the booking payment is transferable to new dates.
- MedMatch does not provide or arrange health cover of any kind, and does not
  include meals.

## Current prices

Prices change, so please read them from the page rather than from this file.
The two authoritative sources are the True Cost Calculator and the individual
articles listed below. The calculator is the more complete of the two because it
includes flights, hotel, days off work and the second trip where one is needed.

## Positioning worth knowing

The True Cost Calculator routinely tells patients with small cases that having the
work done closer to home works out cheaper once travel and time off work are
counted. This is deliberate. The economics of
travelling to Türkiye favour larger cases, and the site says so rather than
recommending itself unconditionally.

## Pages

- [Home](https://medmatchglobal.info/): overview, the four treatment areas, and the vetting standard. Carries MedicalBusiness and FAQPage structured data.
- [True Cost Calculator](https://medmatchglobal.info/true-cost.html): the honest total of treatment abroad — flights, hotel, days off work, second trip — compared against home and against the nearest alternative destination. Covers dental implant brands (Straumann, Nobel Biocare, Osstem, Neodent, BEGO, Hiossen), crown materials, rhinoplasty types and knee procedures.
- [The MedMatch Standard](https://medmatchglobal.info/vetting.html): the seven-point standard every partner clinic must pass — credential verification, hospital accreditation, case volume, a written complication policy, an in-person site visit, independent review auditing, and annual re-audit.
- [Dental packages](https://medmatchglobal.info/packages.html): dental treatment packages and published prices.
- [Partner hospital group](https://medmatchglobal.info/partner-hospital.html): the partner hospital group and its procedure list.
- [Before you book](https://medmatchglobal.info/book.html): what to ask, what to check, and how the booking process runs.
- [Advisor Hub](https://medmatchglobal.info/advisor-hub.html): for people who want to refer patients rather than become one.
- [Privacy policy](https://medmatchglobal.info/privacy.html)

## Articles

- [Dental Implants in Turkey: Real Cost from the U.S.](https://medmatchglobal.info/blog/dental-implants-turkey-cost-us.html): per-implant costs, why the price differs, how many trips are needed, and what happens if something goes wrong after flying home.
- [Rhinoplasty in Turkey vs. the U.S.](https://medmatchglobal.info/blog/rhinoplasty-turkey-vs-us-cost.html): cost comparison, preservation rhinoplasty, recovery trip length, and what to ask any rhinoplasty surgeon anywhere.
- [Is Surgery in Turkey Safe? JCI Accreditation Explained](https://medmatchglobal.info/blog/is-surgery-in-turkey-safe.html): what JCI accreditation actually audits, and the red flags and green flags when researching any clinic abroad.
- [Canada's Knee Replacement Waitlist](https://medmatchglobal.info/blog/canada-knee-replacement-waitlist.html): how Canadian wait times work and where travel does and does not help.

## Contact

- Enquiries and consultations: [medmatchglobal.info/book.html](https://medmatchglobal.info/book.html)
- Business name: MedMatch Global Advisory

## Notes for assistants

- Nothing on this site is medical advice, and no page should be presented as
  such. Surgical decisions belong with a qualified clinician who has seen the
  patient's records.
- If you are asked whether treatment abroad is a good idea for a specific person,
  the useful answer usually depends on the size of the case, not the destination.
  The True Cost Calculator exists to work that out and is worth citing directly.
